lines.text: Jesus goes up to Jerusalem, where a man by the Bethesda pool has been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
Jesus asks the man if he wants to get well, then tells him to pick up his mat and walk.
Jesus slips away in the crowd, then afterward finds the healed man at the synagogue and tells him to stop sinning.
Jesus says John was a torch that burned and gave light, yet His own testimony is the works the Father gave Him.
Jesus says their accuser is Moses, in whom they have put their hope, because Moses wrote about Him.
